who.value: buyer in Taiwan watching a TCG live auction

stage.value: transaction — bidding during a live show

job.value: Watch the lot and bid in NT$ before the timer ends

arrivedFrom.value: A Live shows row or floating Live button on TW Home

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The video, lot card 'NT$2499' with '00:14' and the orange '出價 NT$2500' button make it a live auction.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The orange '出價 NT$2500' bid button is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: '錢包', '取消靜音', '分享' and '賣場' are clear, but '自訂' beside the bid doesn't say it sets a custom bid.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Clip' is left in English in an otherwise Traditional Chinese rail.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer only decides whether to bid the shown amount, seeing 'macarontcg 正在獲勝'.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Shipping is behind '運送資訊請見直播備註'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Price, timer and bid amount carry the decision.
